doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Chicago clubs and freelance recording pay
summary: The Entertainers on 35th, Ory's refusal to sign an exclusive contract, and earning up to $600 in a day freelancing.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Where was the entertainers? On 35th? Yeah, 35th.
Same place at Plantation and... Long in Mexico.

Joe Glavie. Sunset. Sunset. And then Ness was across the street, yeah. So they wanted me to get a band, a recording band together. But I had to sign a contract. I was freelancing. I recorded with all the bands. You see? When you first recorded in Los Angeles?
Yeah, I made much of $600 one day. In Chicago? Yeah. When we were talking...
We were talking with two bands.
